_comment: Scenario battery for node 6a (claude-haiku-4-5, promoted to production 2026-08-04, replacing qwen35-397b-a17b â€” see nodes/retired_qwen_node6/ and .claude/rules/node6-haiku-slim-design.md). Ported from the retired Qwen node's own battery (nodes/retired_qwen_node6/node_6a_name_collection_self_scenarios.json) to cover every guardrail the verbose version had. Each scenario keeps its original ID where the underlying requirement is unchanged; expected_behavior text is reworded where the old design used a numbered Qwen SIGNAL and this design uses a named section or an inherited system-prompt block. Mechanism changed in several cases (e.g. INFO PIVOT / CONTACT CLINIC / CANCEL ESCAPE / WRAP-UP now come from nodes/shared/system_prompt.txt rather than a node-local signal) â€” the pass/fail criterion (what the caller should hear and which tool should fire) is preserved unchanged. Self-audit result at promotion: 36/36 (100%).

scenarios.name: S1 â€” EXECUTE produces speech and smart_voice_agent after email decline

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
Sarah Kowalski
So that's Sarah Kowalski â€” is that right?
Yes, that's right.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
No, I don't have one.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' (name confirmed, phone already known via caller_phone DV, email declined â€” all three resolved, EXECUTE fires in this same turn). FAIL if agent speaks without a smart_voice_agent tool call. FAIL if smart_voice_agent is called silently without the spoken phrase. FAIL if agent re-asks for email or asks any further question.

scenarios.name: S2 â€” Email-decline not recognised: agent re-asks instead of executing

history.content: I need to book in please.
What's your full name for the booking?
Tom Brennan
So that's Tom Brennan â€” is that right?
Yep.
Do you have an email address for the booking?
No.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' (plain 'No.' is read as email declined â€” email is resolved, all three fields resolved, EXECUTE fires). FAIL if agent asks 'Do you have an email address?' or similar again. FAIL if agent calls universal_router instead of smart_voice_agent.

scenarios.name: S3 â€” KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH: DV values injected, single caller message

history.content: [ElevenLabs DV state at node entry]: caller_first_name='Tracy', caller_last_name='Franklin-Briscoe', caller_email='tfranklinbriscoe@gmail.com'
Hi, yes go ahead and book me in.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' (KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH fires: caller_first_name, caller_last_name, caller_email all set, phone known via caller_phone). FAIL if agent asks 'What's your full name for the booking?' (ignored the known DV values). FAIL if smart_voice_agent is called silently with no spoken output.

[universal_router response]: {"intent": "change_time", "success": true}

FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='book' or any other intent instead of smart_voice_agent. FAIL if no tool call is made at all.

What's your full name for the booking?

So that's James Oduya â€” is that right?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'I'm sorry about that â€” let me cancel that booking and rebook you straight away.' AND calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with payload reschedule_mode=true (AFTER BOOKING SUCCEEDS' replacement-mention rule fires, not the system prompt's plain CANCEL ESCAPE). FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent (wrong tool). FAIL if agent asks 'What day would you prefer?' without making any tool call.

scenarios.name: S7 â€” NDIS coverage question mid name-collection routes to INFO PIVOT (inherited from system prompt)

history.content: I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
Actually wait, is this covered under NDIS?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='info_pivot' with called_number, caller_id in the same turn (the system prompt's INFO PIVOT block covers general clinic questions including NDIS/Medicare/coverage â€” this node has no local override for it). FAIL if agent fabricates an NDIS coverage answer directly. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent instead of universal_router. FAIL if agent calls universal_router silently with no filler phrase. FAIL if agent asks 'What's your full name for the booking?' again without addressing the coverage question at all.

scenarios.name: S8 â€” Boundary: refund question fires node-local FINANCIAL ENQUIRY, not system-prompt INFO PIVOT

history.content: Hi, I want to book in.
What's your full name for the booking?
Before that â€” can I get a refund for my last visit?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Our team handles billing directly â€” would you like me to get someone to call you back?' (this node's FINANCIAL ENQUIRY block fires â€” refunds are billing-admin, not a coverage/rebate or plain-price question). FAIL if agent routes via universal_router intent='info_pivot' (scope creep â€” refunds are billing-admin, not general info). FAIL if agent fabricates a refund policy answer directly.

scenarios.name: S8b â€” Boundary: plain cost question now goes to the system prompt's PRICING QUERY, not FINANCIAL ENQUIRY (deliberate change from the Qwen version â€” see node6-haiku-slim-design.md)

history.content: Hi, I want to book in.
What's your full name for the booking?
Actually, how much does it cost?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent does NOT offer a billing callback for this â€” a plain cost question with appointment_type_id already resolved should go through the system prompt's PRICING QUERY (filler + universal_router intent='get_service_price'), per this node's FINANCIAL ENQUIRY block explicitly carving out plain-price questions. FAIL if agent says 'Our team handles billing directly â€” would you like me to get someone to call you back?' for a plain cost question (that response is reserved for invoices/refunds/payment-plan/outstanding-balance questions in this design).

scenarios.name: S9 â€” RESUMPTION after aside: no 'Now,' refocusing prefix

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
What's the cost fees?
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "price": "$160", "service": "Initial Consultation"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent's response states the price AND re-asks the pending name question in its original exact wording with no refocusing lead-in, e.g. 'The cost for the Initial Consultation is one hundred and sixty dollars. What's your full name for the booking?'. FAIL if the resumption is prefixed with 'Now,' or 'So,'. FAIL if the agent omits the pending name question entirely after answering the price.

scenarios.name: S11 â€” patient_name_raw already known skips name re-ask, asks email instead, no recap

history.content: Hi, this is Tanya Marshall calling to book in with Sean.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Do you have an email address for the booking?' directly (no booking recap before it) â€” patient_name_raw='Tanya Marshall' contains two tokens, name step is silent, this design never has a recap/APPOINTMENT CONFIRMATION block at all. FAIL if agent asks 'What's your full name for the booking?' or 'I just need your last name' (ignored patient_name_raw). FAIL if agent says any recap phrase like 'Perfect, 5 PM...' before the email question. FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn (name known, email not yet collected â€” no field resolved to book yet).

scenarios.name: S12 â€” Parking question mid name-collection routes to INFO PIVOT (inherited from system prompt), never fabricated

history.content: I'd like to book an appointment.
What's your full name for the booking?
Right. Where can I park?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='info_pivot' with called_number, caller_id in the same turn. FAIL if the agent fabricates any specific parking answer (e.g. describing free street parking) instead of routing to info_pivot â€” this is a known live-call hallucination risk. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent instead of universal_router. FAIL if agent calls universal_router silently with no filler phrase. FAIL if agent asks 'What's your full name for the booking?' again without addressing the parking question at all.

scenarios.name: PNR1 â€” patient_name_raw known via DV alone (not restated in the caller's message): NAME step recognises it without re-asking (regression scenario for a gap found in round-1 self-audit â€” S11/FT1/CE1 happened to pass without exercising this exact path because the caller's message restated the name)

history.content: Yeah, that time works for me.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent proceeds directly past name collection â€” either silently to the phone/email question, or to CONFIRM if a spelling check is warranted â€” using 'Michael Bourke' split via the token rule, with NO 'What's your full name for the booking?' question asked, even though patient_name_raw was set only via DV and the caller's own message contains no name at all. FAIL if agent asks 'What's your full name for the booking?' (failed to check patient_name_raw as an already-known source). FAIL if agent says any recap phrase. FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn (phone/email not yet confirmed as resolved).

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.

No, I don't have one.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with a session_id parameter included in the payload (not omitted). FAIL if the tool call is made without a session_id field â€” this is a required field on the tool's own schema, not optional.

scenarios.name: TOOL2 â€” FINANCIAL ENQUIRY callback_request payload includes caller_name, not just callback_reason (found missing in the same audit)

history.content: Hi, I want to book in.
What's your full name for the booking?
Marcus Webb

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='callback_request' with a payload that includes BOTH caller_name (using 'Marcus Webb', already known from earlier in the call) AND callback_reason. FAIL if the payload includes callback_reason but omits caller_name â€” the tool's documented schema expects both, and the name is already available, not something that still needs asking.

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment. My name's Anthony Dukes.

Yes, that's right.

It's a, n, t, h, o, n, y, dot, j, u, k, e, s, at gmail dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent silently corrects the stored surname to 'Jukes' and proceeds directly to the email confirmation question, e.g. 'So that's anthony.jukes at gmail dot com â€” is that right?', with NO separate question raised about the Dukes/Jukes spelling discrepancy. FAIL if the agent asks a clarifying question like 'Is your last name spelled with a J or a D?' FAIL if the agent keeps 'Dukes' and never reconciles the mismatch at all.

So that's Rebecca Sinclair â€” is that right?
Yes.
Do you have an email address for the booking?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent asks a clarifying question noting the surname in the email ('Montgomery') doesn't match the surname given ('Sinclair'). FAIL if the agent silently overwrites 'Sinclair' with 'Montgomery' (or vice versa) without asking. FAIL if the agent ignores the mismatch entirely and proceeds straight to execute.

scenarios.name: AG1 â€” Spelling-confidence gate fires on sound-alike pair (Cain/Kane)

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book in please. My last name's Cain.

(Cain/Kane is explicitly listed as a sound-alike pair). FAIL if the agent assumes one spelling without confirming which. FAIL if the agent asks for the full name again instead of a targeted spelling question.

FAIL if agent reads back with the plain 'So that's...' template with no mismatch highlighted. FAIL if agent skips the email readback entirely.

FAIL if agent says 'Hello, are you still there?' or any generic dead-air phrase (the system prompt's default DEAD AIR handling fired instead of RECOVERY). scenarios.name: EP2 â€” Email patience: two confused replies in a row triggers the skip offer

scenarios.name: AC1 â€” After name collected: email question only, no booking recap

history.content: What's your full name for the booking?
Matthew Sparks.

scenarios.name: CE1 â€” All DVs set (name + email on file): KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH executes directly, no recap, no email question

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' â€” KNOWN-CALLER FAST-PATH fires because caller_first_name, caller_last_name, and caller_email are all set. FAIL if agent says any recap phrase before executing. FAIL if agent asks 'Do you have an email address for the booking?'. FAIL if smart_voice_agent is called silently without the spoken phrase.

scenarios.name: NCZ1 â€” No tool call between name confirmation and the next question

history.content: Hi, I need to book a physio appointment.
What is your full name for the booking?

FAIL if agent says 'So that's Diane Gatenby â€” is that right?' without asking for spelling â€” this is the exact live bug where 'Gatenby' was transcribed as 'Gaytonby' and confirmed incorrectly. FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'And could you spell your last name for me?'. FAIL if agent says 'So that's John Smith â€” is that right?' and moves straight to email â€” the last-name spell rule has no exception for common surnames. FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn.

scenarios.name: LS3 â€” Spelled last name read back letter by letter before moving on

scenarios.name: FT1 â€” First turn, name unknown: no recap, directly asks for name

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book'. FAIL if agent asks for phone or email (both already known). FAIL if smart_voice_agent is called silently. FAIL if agent calls universal_router instead.

H, O, L, T

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'And what's a good number to reach you on?' â€” phone is not resolved (both caller_phone and caller_id are empty), so EXECUTE cannot fire yet even though name and email are both resolved.
